title: Sales Performance Dashboard
description: Sample data analytics project demonstrating how sales data can be summarized into a clear dashboard for monitoring revenue, trends and product performance.
objective: Demonstrate a practical workflow for transforming structured sales data into useful business insights and dashboard-ready metrics.
steps: Reviewed the dataset structure and identified the main business metrics.
Cleaned and prepared the data for analysis.
Calculated summary metrics such as revenue, sales volume and product performance.
Organized the results into charts and dashboard-style views.
Reviewed the outputs for consistency and clear presentation.
results: Created a sample dashboard concept that presents key sales indicators and trends in a format suitable for business reporting.

challenges.problem: Raw business data can contain inconsistent values and require preparation before visualization.
challenges.solution: Applied a structured cleaning and validation workflow before calculating metrics and creating visual summaries.
